requirements.rule: Art. 45 c. 23 (p. 43) also owes, for the compulsory absence for pregnancy and puerperium, 'la 13° mensilità limitatamente all'aliquota corrispondente al 20% della retribuzione': not paid by the engine. The holiday target includes a stated weekday patron day. A Sunday holiday is paid by its own quota rather than this top-up; 4 October, introduced after the text was signed, remains excluded.
requirements.remediation: Resolve the Sunday holiday's separate quota, 4 October and the 20% thirteenth-month share.
